sources.discovery: UTC date directories; timestamped CAMHDA301-YYYYMMDDTHHMMSS.mp4 files

sources.name: Ocean Networks Canada observatories
sources.description: Candidate deep-seafloor observatory video; no validated public ingestion endpoint.
sources.operator: Ocean Networks Canada / University of Victoria
sources.discovery: Oceans 3.0 camera API tested on GitHub runner; unauthenticated request returned 401. Dataset ownership and any token configuration require review.
limitations: Camera API returned 401 without a token on the deployment runner

sources.name: NOAA Ocean Exploration
sources.description: Candidate expedition ROV footage; expedition-dependent, not a continuous fixed camera.
sources.discovery: Current NOAA data-access page identifies the NCEI Ocean Exploration Video Portal as an archive with downloadable video. A recurring ingestion adapter is not yet validated.
limitations: NOAA explicitly describes video on its named Ocean Exploration Video Portal as public domain; this is not a blanket license for unrelated website images
Specific media retrieval, metadata normalization and recurring archive discovery remain unverified

sources.name: MBARI research video
sources.description: Candidate research ROV footage; no confirmed regularly updating unauthenticated feed.
sources.discovery: Investigate institutional video catalog and reuse policy
limitations: Current website materials license covers non-commercial classroom education; personal use and non-classroom copying require written permission
No suitable recurring direct media endpoint has been verified; no request was sent to MBARI
